title: Selection of the class of the shared bias-only correction from training data (retrospective DEV)
question: Can the function class of g (including none = C0_refit) be selected per dataset from training data only, so that the selected method is not worse than C0_refit on any dataset and close to the best fixed class?
retrospective_note: Menu, datasets, I9-2 per-class rows and I8-2 S3 values were seen before this pre-registration; the S_gate selections are known (S3_f < 0 on sky130 12/12, NIST 4 K 53/53, TU Delft 5/7, IHP 300 K 0/18, NIST RT 87/87). Prospective test: December TEST stage.

secondary_datasets.nist_rt: I9-1 NIST room temperature DEV, 87 devices; S_gate and S_cv over {none, poly3 (B3_d3), mlp16 (M_bias)}; 95%, descriptive

outer.held_out_score: stored I9-2 per_device row of the selected class (none -> C0_refit)

inner.design: groups sorted by (family of first device, group); leave-one-group-out if <= 12 groups, else 4 folds (group i -> fold i mod 4)
inner.recipe: I9-2 class settings; MLP classes seed 0 only

selectors.S_loss: mean over inner held-out devices of ln(RRMS(I_sim exp(g_X)) / RRMS(I_sim)) on starting-card records (post hoc, no refit)
selectors.S_refit: same inner corrections; inner held-out cards refit with g frozen (max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01, I9-2 refit path); ln(RRMS_refit / RRMS_C0_refit stored); scope all inner devices except NIST (inner fold = outer position mod 4)
selectors.S_gate: mlp16 iff stored fold-level S3_f < 0 else none
selectors.S_cv: mean over the fold's training devices of ln(RRMS_X / RRMS_C0_refit) from stored I9-2 rows (not strictly nested; see D9)

selection_rule.blocked: non-finite inner value on a device with finite reference

statistics.pooled: equal dataset weight, i9_2_classes.pooled_ratio, 20000 stratified resamples, default_rng(0)
statistics.clusters: TU Delft geometry groups (primary); device bootstrap secondary
contrasts: GMR(S, S_gate) for S_loss, S_refit, S_cv

decision_rule.C1: every primary dataset: upper Bonferroni CI of GMR(S, C0_refit) <= 1.03
decision_rule.C2: pooled upper Bonferroni CI of GMR(S, mlp16) <= 1.03
decision_rule.label: supported (C1 and C2) / partly supported / not supported
overall: continue: class selection adds to the gate, if a supported multi-class selector has pooled GMR(S, S_gate) upper < 1 (frozen: lowest GMR(S, S_gate))
else continue: gate only, if S_gate supported
else continue: multi-class selector (lowest pooled GMR(S, C0_refit), ties 0.005 -> cheaper: S_gate, S_cv, S_loss, S_refit)

validity.V_rows: presence of every row and fold model (checked before prereg: pass)
validity.V_fold: lin retrain per outer fold = stored I9-2 lin model, max |coef diff| <= 1e-12

post_hoc_references.oracle_pooled: lowest pooled GMR(X, C0_refit) over M5 (gam from I9-2)
post_hoc_references.oracle_per_dataset: lowest per-dataset GMR (gam, gam, gam, lin from I9-2)

test_protocol: see prereg.md: frozen selector run on all DEV devices before TEST is loaded; selected class per TEST dataset committed; class trained on all DEV records (5 seeds for MLP), TEST cards refit with g frozen; GMR(selected, C0_refit) per dataset and pooled, GMR(selected, M_bias); C1 / C2 at 95%, margin 1.03; TEST sets: 7 I8-2 TEST datasets + NIST TEST of I8-1 (38) and I9-1 (58)
